description: The installation of 2 no. internally illuminated fascia signs and associated digital display infrastructure, including 2 no. LED ribbon screens and 4 no. LCD panel screens to West Hall. The digital display screens would be capable of both sequential content and full motion display.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The period of this consent shall expire 5 years from the date of this notice.

Condition required to be imposed by the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 1992.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC6, DC8 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 3 - Signage identified as types 1 and 2 on the approved 'Elevation � Main Entrance Proposed Drawing Number AEG-HTL-WE-ZZ-DR-A-004002 Rev P01' are limited to internal static illumination only. Signage identified as types 3, 4 and 5 on the approved 'Elevation � Main Entrance Proposed Drawing Number AEG-HTL-WE-ZZ-DR-A-004002 Rev P01' can be operated with internal illumination and moving images in accordance with the approved details.

To ensure that the amenity of neighbouring occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely impacted by changing light patterns from artificial light, in accordance with Policy CC12 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The illumination of the sign/advertisement shall comply with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/20: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light' and the 'Professional Lighting Guide No 5, 2023- Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements'.

The intensity of the illumination of the advertisement screens permitted by this consent also shall be within that recommended by the Institute of Lighting Professionals in its Professional Lighting Guide 05/23 'The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements Including Digital Displays'.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies CC12 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - In the interest of visual and residential amenity, the advertisements hereby approved shall only be illuminated during the opening hours of the business to which the advertisement relates.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policy CC11 and CC12 of the Local Plan (2018).
